reviewed_contract: Explicit root release composes all three exact lexical-driver scalar gates before launch; source/control/checkpoint/venv input closure and physical four-UUID inventory are pinned
All original Goop identities must have exited and no original or duplicate gate executable can remain; the wrapper owns only B GPUs0/1 and never controls Sand GPUs2/3

Exact mapping is seed0 then seed2 on GPU0 and seed1 on GPU1; all rollout children bind one common selection; test parent and children bind exactly one capacity receipt with common protocol/driver/cohort/selection, quotas, two-wave allocation and reserves

Fresh root clock check, common first-wave latest start, positive per-invocation quotas and complete remaining wave budget preserve bounded cleanup and independent analysis reserves; the unchanged driver handles shifted seed2 admission

Each owned process is registered before fallible identity checking; inherited SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGKILL cleanup targets owned identities, reaps children and prevents final ledger publication if any child remains unreaped
Only lightweight metadata/process checks run while children are active; full file hashing and complete collection parsing wait until every owned child stops

Label, capacity, infrastructure and timeout failures stop the phase; test scientific guard failures preserve the complete fixed360-cell grid; accounting errors retain launched/reaped identities instead of relabeling them never-started
Nested driver execution_budget evidence is retained and classified as inner timeout; raw failed-attempt evidence and all partial outputs remain available

Final ledger is serialized before terminal input, collection, evidence-tree and analysis-cutoff checks; scalar collection pins and original supervisor evidence bytes cannot be silently adopted after serialization

A reaped historical PID on unassigned GPU2/3 is removed only from the observation ownership map after a changed or absent current identity; frozen strict checks continue for all assigned-device rows and every live owned child

limitations: Independent source, scalar and inert synthetic-process review only; no official scientific arrays/checkpoints, actual model inference/training, real GPU/process inspection, network or remote actions
The parent validates scalar collection structure and byte pins; numerical NPZ contents and scientific outcomes require the separately reviewed fitter/root collector
Every execution still requires an exact fresh root release and admitted measured resource budget; this review does not authorize launch, test access, scientific conclusions or publication
